description: This is a Java source file implementing a customValve class 'CrossSubdomainSessionValve' for Apache Tomcat which modifies session cookie handling to support cross-subdomain sessions. It extends ValveBase and overrides the invoke method to replace session cookies with customized domain settings.

classes.name: CrossSubdomainSessionValve
classes.description: A custom Valve class for Tomcat that modifies session cookie handling to enable cross-subdomain sessions.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Overrides the invoke method to ensure session creation and replace the session cookie with domain customization before proceeding to the next valve.

methods.name: replaceCookie
methods.description: Replaces the session cookie in the response with a version that has a domain attribute set to support cross-subdomain sessions, ensuring the cookie's security properties are preserved.
